Senior Technical Product Manager, RAN Digital Twin

NVIDIA · Santa Clara, CA (and US remote) · Senior


ROLE SUMMARY

Lead end-to-end development and ecosystem strategy for NVIDIA's Radio Access Network (RAN) Digital Twin portfolio. Drive the roadmap for a software-defined platform that simulates, optimizes, and validates radio access networks in a physically accurate digital environment.

Team / product: RAN (Radio Access Network) Digital Twin portfolio — unifying high-performance computing, AI, and wireless simulation on NVIDIA's accelerated infrastructure for global telecom operators (5G evolving toward AI-native 6G).


QUALIFICATIONS

- 8+ years of PM experience in wireless communications industry AND 7+ years of PM experience in software simulation tools / HPC / SaaS tool development.
- BS/MS or equivalent in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical field.
- Deep customer insights and business perspective on RAN digital twins (researchers, developers, integrators, NEMs, telecom operators).
- Strong technical background in wireless communications and detailed understanding of AI-native RAN (HW + SW).
- Outstanding communication and project management skills.
- Stand out: direct experience with NVIDIA software (Aerial, Omniverse) and SDKs; large-scale simulations and multi-sensor data; concept-to-launch product ownership.


RESPONSIBILITIES

- Own the product lifecycle of the RAN Digital Twin portfolio, concept through launch and ongoing lifecycle management.
- Articulate the value props of different digital twin architectures and map them to specific workloads and telco use cases.
- Define product requirements (PRDs) and prioritize reference architectures for key verticals.
- Distill insights from strategic customers and partners to define, prioritize, and execute product roadmaps.
- Analyze competitive products; engage key opinion leaders on next-gen technology adoption.
- Develop business requirement, user stories, product definition and specifications, and value propositions.
- Work with engineering, operations, and field teams on GTM plans and product positioning.
- Partner with sales to build collateral and tools to drive adoption of digital twin technologies.
